items.title: Dying 4 – “Topaz”
items.summary: Dying 4 release their debut EP Perish Songs next month. The indietronica project of Blue Bendy guitarist Joseph Nash unveiled "Strafe" last month, and now he's sharing the sprawling, twitchy tune "Topaz." The post Dying 4 – “Topaz” appeared first on Stereogum.

items.title: Jess Williamson – “Tracking The Tropics”
items.summary: Last month, Jess Williamson announced her new album A Mile South Of Heaven and shared the poignant lead single "Goodbye To All That." Now, the country-folk artist is back with another charming, pedal steel-adorned beaut called "Tracking The Tropics." The post Jess Williamson – “Tracking The Tropics” appeared first on Stereogum.

items.title: Lily Seabird – “The Afterglow”
items.summary: Lily Seabird has been blowing us away with her Lightspheres On Their Way singles. Since last year's Trash Mountain, the Burlington singer-songwriter has been leaning into loudness with "Election Day" and "Portal To The Past," but she's returning to a mellow acoustic sound with today's offering "The Afterglow," which was partly inspired by the death of folk legend Michael Hurley.
